chunks.text: Spherical CNNs replace the plane with the sphere as the domain of the signal, which is exactly right for data like molecules and the atmosphere.

chunks.text: The catch is that their core operation, spherical convolution, is most accurate in the spectral domain, and that is far more expensive than an ordinary planar convolution.
